cs.t: Changed many laptops in the past 20 years. I have run Linux on dell XPS, Asus zensomething, now hp dragonfly.  No problem.
cs.th: I dumped Windows 11 for Linux, and you should too

cs.t: I've been a dev for almost 20 years. Though a bulky laptop with finest specs would be great, I need mobility so I had luck with these three. Super portable, yet powerful. 1. Dell XPS 13 2. Lenovo X1 Carbon 3. HP Dragonfly Elite (current) Regardless of the brand I always stuc with i7/16Gb and at least 512Gb NVMe storage. One downside with my current machine (HP Dragonfly) is it comes with 8th Gen intel processor not really a big problem for me, but fan it a bit louder to my liking. Coming to Linux compatibility I've used Dell XPS 13 and Lenovo X1 with no issues. Haven't tried Linux on the current machine yet.
